fact: By service note n°082/MEPSTA/CAB/SG of 2 August 2021 the minister ordered that the list of pupils of every public school, with their final results, be centralised each year, that regional directors obtain the same from private schools, and that CNDP-TICE create a single marks-management platform for all public and private schools, consultable at every level of the system; the platform was ordered, not in use, and no school level is named.
title: Togo-Vers la création d'une plateforme unique de gestion de notes des élèves
